text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer connected paragraphs with transitions like \"First of all,\" \"For example,\" and \"In addition\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay uses paragraphing and transition words to build a more coherent line of thought."},{"evidence":"\"my mom was vary sick\" \"could not do nothing\" \"to many people die\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows somewhat stronger control of sentence structure and can sustain longer sentences with clearer overall meaning."},{"evidence":"\"I would like to pursue to be a Doctor\" \"want to be doctors\" \"work for sick people\"","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay develops its main point with multiple supporting reasons and examples rather than repeating a single experience."},{"evidence":"\"help people with cancer or lost a leg a arm\" \"they work 24/7 non stop to help us\"","quality":"supporting detail","description":"The essay includes more specific examples and elaboration to explain why the writer wants the job."},{"evidence":"\"First of all\" \"In addition\" \"In closing\" \"In conclusion\"","quality":"text structure awareness","description":"The essay shows clearer awareness of introducing, adding, and closing ideas in an essay format."}]}
